title: Consecutive Posterior Fusion for Diffusive Recovery of Unobservable Image Structures
title_zh: 用于不可观测图像结构扩散恢复的连续后验融合

paragraphs.en: Solving severely ill-posed imaging inverse problems requires recovering image structures that are unobservable or weakly constrained by the measurements. Diffusion models provide expressive learned priors for inferring such missing information, while posterior sampling incorporates measurement consistency along the reverse process. Standard diffusion posterior samplers, however, rely on instantaneous measurement-aware estimates, without explicitly exploiting information carried by previous posterior corrections.
paragraphs.zh: 解决严重不适定的成像反问题需要恢复那些无法通过测量直接观测到或仅受弱约束的图像结构。 扩散模型能够生成具有表现力的学习先验，用于推断此类缺失信息，而后验采样则在反向过程中融入了测量一致性。 然而，标准的扩散后验采样器依赖于瞬时且感知测量的估计值，并未显式利用先前后验修正所携带的信息。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Consecutive Posterior Fusion Denoising Diffusion Null-Space Models (CPF-DDNM), an inference-time strategy that fuses consecutive measurement-aware estimates to improve the diffusive recovery of unobservable image structures, without requiring retraining or additional denoiser evaluations. We instantiate this principle within DDNM, whose range/null-space decomposition reveals that consecutive fusion preserves the measurement-determined component while acting exclusively on the prior-driven null-space estimate. We thus provide a geometric interpretation of CPF-DDNM and a local error analysis that characterizes the optimal time-dependent fusion coefficient, including the extrapolative regime.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了连续后验融合去噪扩散零空间模型（CPF-DDNM），这是一种推理时的策略，通过融合连续的测量感知估计值，来改善对不可观测图像结构的扩散恢复过程，而无需重新训练或进行额外的去噪器评估。 我们在 DDNM 框架内具体实现了这一原则。其值域/零空间分解表明，连续融合能够保留由测量决定的分量，同时仅作用于由先验驱动的零空间估计值。 因此，我们为 CPF-DDNM 提供了几何解释，并进行了局部误差分析，以描述最优的时间依赖融合系数，包括外推阶段的情况。

paragraphs.en: Imaging inverse problems aim to recover an unknown image from indirect measurements related to it through a physical acquisition process. In many practical imaging settings, these measurements may be incomplete, undersampled, or affected by noise, making the reconstruction problem severely ill-posed [ 2 ] . Such situations arise, for example, in computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), inpainting, and super-resolution. In these settings, the acquisition process may not uniquely determine the image: undersampling leaves components that are unobservable from the data, while measurement noise further increases the uncertainty along weakly observable directions of the forward operator. The quality of the reconstruction therefore depends critically on the prior used to infer the missing or poorly constrained information.
paragraphs.zh: 成像反问题旨在通过物理采集过程，从与之相关的间接测量值中恢复出未知图像。 在许多实际成像场景中，这些测量值可能不完整、欠采样或受到噪声影响，导致重建问题严重不适定 [ 2 ] 。 例如，在计算机断层扫描（CT）、磁共振成像（MRI）、图像修复和超分辨率等应用中就会出现此类情况。 在这些场景中，采集过程可能无法唯一确定图像：欠采样会留下无法从数据中观测到的成分，而测量噪声则会进一步增加前向算子弱可观测方向上的不确定性。 因此，重建质量的关键取决于用于推断缺失或约束不足信息的先验知识。

paragraphs.en: Classical variational methods resolve this ambiguity through handcrafted regularizers that promote properties such as sparsity, smoothness, or structural consistency [ 6 , 11 , 12 ] . Deep learning provides an alternative route by learning image statistics directly from data. In medical reconstruction, learned components have been employed as post-processing operators [ 13 , 23 ] , embedded in unrolled optimization schemes [ 10 , 20 ] , or combined with explicit model-based procedures [ 24 ] . More recently, diffusion generative models have emerged as expressive learned priors for inverse problems. Among the broad family of approaches employing diffusion models to drive the image reconstruction problem, in this work we focus on diffusion posterior sampling methods. These methods typically combine a pretrained generative prior with measurement-aware corrections throughout the reverse trajectory, thereby selecting plausible solutions that remain compatible with the observed data. paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have been widely adopted as learned priors for imaging inverse problems. Existing approaches differ primarily in how measurement information is incorporated into the reverse process. DDRM [ 16 ] derives posterior updates for linear degradation operators through their spectral decomposition. DPS [ 5 ] introduces approximate likelihood gradients and can address noisy and nonlinear inverse problems. DDNM [ 27 ] enforces measurement consistency through an explicit range/null-space decomposition, whereas DiffPIR [ 35 ] embeds a pretrained diffusion denoiser within a plug-and-play half-quadratic splitting scheme. Although these approaches implement data consistency differently, they all generate a sequence of measurement-aware estimates along the reverse trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型已被广泛用作成像反问题中的学习先验。 现有方法的主要区别在于如何将测量信息整合到反向过程中。 DDRM [ 16 ] 通过线性退化算子的谱分解推导出后验更新。 DPS [ 5 ] 引入了近似似然梯度，能够处理含噪声和非线性的反问题。 DDNM [ 27 ] 通过显式的值域/零空间分解来强制测量一致性，而 DiffPIR [ 35 ] 则将预训练的扩散去噪器嵌入到即插即用的半二次分裂方案中。 尽管这些方法实现数据一致性的方式不同，但它们都在反向轨迹上生成了一系列考虑了测量信息的估计值。

paragraphs.en: To speed up the generation process or improve the stability of the diffusion trajectory, several works have recently investigated multistep discretizations of the reverse diffusion dynamics [ 18 , 21 , 33 ] . These approaches exploit information from multiple diffusion steps to construct higher-order approximations of the generative trajectory. By comparison, the temporal relation between consecutive measurement-aware estimates in diffusion posterior samplers remains comparatively underexplored.

paragraphs.en: A recent step in this direction is LAMP [ 8 ] , which introduces a lagged temporal correction derived from a second-order discretization of the posterior dynamics. LAMP provides initial evidence that consecutive measurement-aware estimates contain useful information that is discarded by standard posterior-sampling updates. Its formulation is backbone-independent and was validated on DiffPIR and DDRM using a linear combination of consecutive estimates. However, due to the second-order discretization formulation, it always resulted in a convex combination of successive measurement-aware terms with coefficients β t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \beta_{t}\in[0,1] . On the other side, CPF-DDNM focuses on the extrapolative regime, where consecutive estimates define an over-relaxation direction within the null-space. Thus, the two methods exploit the same source of temporal information in different regimes and for different purposes.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have also attracted growing interest in medical image reconstruction, where they provide flexible learned priors for highly ill-posed acquisition problems [ 17 , 29 ] . Applications include sparse-view and low-dose CT, accelerated MRI, PET reconstruction, and multimodal imaging. In CT, diffusion-based methods have been proposed for sparse-view reconstruction and artifact reduction, including approaches that incorporate the acquisition model directly into the generative process [ 30 , 32 ] . Related posterior-sampling strategies have been developed for accelerated MRI and joint PET–MRI reconstruction [ 1 , 31 ] . Most of these works focus on modality-specific conditioning mechanisms, data-consistency operators, or posterior-sampling rules. CPF-DDNM is complementary to these developments: it modifies how an existing DDNM solver uses consecutive measurement-aware estimates, without retraining or changing the underlying diffusion prior.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型在医学图像重建领域也引起了日益增长的兴趣，它们为高度不适定的采集问题提供了灵活的已学习先验 [ 17 , 29 ] 。 其应用包括稀疏视图和低剂量 CT、加速 MRI、PET 重建以及多模态成像。 在 CT 领域，基于扩散的方法已被用于稀疏视图重建和伪影抑制，其中包括将采集模型直接整合到生成过程中的方法 [ 30 , 32 ] 。 相关的后验采样策略也已被开发用于加速 MRI 和联合 PET–MRI 重建 [ 1 , 31 ] 。 这些研究大多关注特定模态的条件机制、数据一致性算子或后验采样规则。 CPF-DDNM 与这些发展互为补充：它修改了现有 DDNM 求解器使用连续测量感知估计的方式，而无需重新训练或改变底层的扩散先验。

paragraphs.en: The generative process described in Section 3.1 can produce high-quality samples, although it does not directly control which image is generated. paragraphs.en: Training was performed using a discrete DDPM forward process with T = 1000 T=1000 diffusion timesteps. paragraphs.en: We evaluate CPF-DDNM on two medical imaging inverse problems: computed tomography reconstruction and single-image super-resolution. paragraphs.en: Single-image super-resolution aims to reconstruct a high-resolution image from a spatially downsampled observation. In the setting considered in this work, each low-resolution pixel is obtained by averaging the intensities over a non-overlapping block of high-resolution pixels. This operation removes fine-scale anatomical information, including small structures and sharp tissue boundaries, which cannot be uniquely recovered from the observed image alone.

paragraphs.en: The parameters of the comparison methods were tuned on the training set and then kept fixed across all test images within the same task and acquisition setting. For DDNM and CPF-DDNM, we set Δ ​ t = 50 \Delta t=50 in all experiments which, together with T = 1000 T=1000 , results in N = 20 N=20 reverse diffusion steps. In the CT experiments, the action of the pseudo-inverse 𝑲 † \bm{K}^{\dagger} was approximated using CGLS with J = 16 J=16 iterations, a setting that provided stable performance across the considered acquisition conditions. Note that limiting the number of CGLS iterations introduces an implicit regularization effect, since early termination reduces the amplification of measurement noise along poorly determined components of the inverse problem. paragraphs.en: As expected, the performance of most reconstruction methods improves as the number of acquired views increases. CPF-DDNM achieves the best mean values for all three evaluation metrics and for all the considered acquisition geometries, yielding the highest SSIM and PSNR values and the lowest LPIPS scores. For the most challenging 30-view geometry, the CPF-DDNM performance is very close to that of DiffPIR. Nevertheless, CPF-DDNM provides a clear improvement over the original DDNM baseline, increasing the SSIM from 0.7837 0.7837 to 0.8511 0.8511 and the PSNR from 31.06 31.06 to 32.40 ​ dB 32.40\,\mathrm{dB} , while reducing the LPIPS from 0.1322 0.1322 to 0.0829 0.0829 .
paragraphs.zh: 正如预期，随着采集视角数量的增加，大多数重建方法的性能都会得到提升。 CPF-DDNM 在所有三种评估指标以及所有所考虑的采集几何构型中均取得了最佳均值，从而获得了最高的 SSIM 和 PSNR 值，以及最低的 LPIPS 分数。 对于最具挑战性的 30 视角几何构型，CPF-DDNM 的性能与 DiffPIR 非常接近。 尽管如此，CPF-DDNM 相较于原始的 DDNM 基线仍实现了显著提升：SSIM 从 0.7837 提升至 0.8511，PSNR 从 31.06 提升至 32.40 \,\mathrm{dB}，同时 LPIPS 从 0.1322 降低至 0.0829。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 provides a qualitative comparison of the reconstruction methods for the 30-, 45-, and 60-view geometries, shown from top to bottom, respectively. As expected, the reconstruction quality progressively improves as the number of projection angles increases, with better-defined anatomical structures and a reduction of streaking and blurring artifacts. For the most challenging 30-view geometry, FBP and SIRT are strongly affected by reconstruction artifacts, whereas ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -TV suppresses most of the streaks but produces an overly smoothed appearance. The diffusion-based methods provide more anatomically plausible reconstructions, although DPS and PS+ show limited structural fidelity. DiffPIR, DDNM, and CPF-DDNM recover the main anatomical structures more accurately, with CPF-DDNM providing slightly sharper boundaries and better preservation of fine details. The differences among the methods become clearer for the 45- and 60-view geometries. As more projection information becomes available, CPF-DDNM more effectively combines measurement consistency with the learned prior. These qualitative observations are consistent with the quantitative results reported in Table 1 . Overall, these results confirm the effectiveness of consecutive posterior fusion in improving the reconstruction quality of the original DDNM baseline.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present the results obtained in the experiments simulating low-dose acquisitions as described in Section 4.3.1 . Figure 6 evaluates the robustness of the reconstruction methods to different noise levels. The bar plots report the mean SSIM and LPIPS values obtained over the entire test set and across five runs with different initial noise realizations. The whiskers represent the corresponding standard deviations. As expected, reconstruction quality generally deteriorates as the noise intensity increases, as indicated by decreasing SSIM values and increasing LPIPS values. CPF-DDNM achieves the highest SSIM values across all the considered noise levels. Regarding LPIPS, DiffPIR provides the best performance at the lowest noise level, δ = 0.1 \delta=0.1 , whereas CPF-DDNM achieves the lowest values for δ = 0.3 \delta=0.3 and δ = 0.5 \delta=0.5 . Interestingly, the relative advantage of CPF-DDNM becomes more pronounced as the measurement noise increases, particularly at the highest noise level. These results indicate that consecutive posterior fusion improves the robustness of the original DDNM formulation and remains effective under increasingly severe measurement noise. The qualitative results confirm that CPF-DDNM yields the best reconstruction, as further highlighted by the magnified view of a low-contrast region. In particular, noise is effectively suppressed while preserving sharp and well-defined object boundaries.

paragraphs.en: The qualitative comparison in Figure 7 , however, reveals a marked discrepancy with this quantitative ranking. Among the methods shown, CPF-DDNM therefore provides the most convincing visual results for these two noisy examples, despite the lower average metric scores reported in Table 2 . sents.zh: 相比之下，CPF-DDNM 生成的组织边界更为锐利，并保留了 DiffPIR 重建图像中不太明显的若干局部细节。

sents.en: Among the methods shown, CPF-DDNM therefore provides the most convincing visual results for these two noisy examples, despite the lower average metric scores reported in Table 2 .
sents.zh: 因此，在所示的方法中，尽管表 2 报告的平均指标分数较低，CPF-DDNM 在这两个含噪声的例子中仍提供了最具说服力的视觉效果。

sents.en: This discrepancy illustrates that global image-quality metrics such as LPIPS may also be insensitive to localized differences that are clinically or anatomically relevant.
sents.zh: 这种差异表明，LPIPS 等全局图像质量指标可能对具有临床或解剖学相关性的局部差异不敏感。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced CPF-DDNM, a lightweight inference-time strategy for improving the prior-driven recovery of unobservable image components in DDNM-based inverse solvers. The method exploits information already available along the reverse diffusion trajectory by combining consecutive measurement-aware estimates, without modifying or retraining the diffusion prior.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 CPF-DDNM，这是一种轻量级的推理时策略，旨在提升基于 DDNM 的反向求解器中不可观测图像成分的先验驱动恢复效果。 该方法通过结合连续的测量感知估计值，利用反向扩散轨迹中已有的信息，而无需修改或重新训练扩散先验。

sents.en: In this work, we introduced CPF-DDNM, a lightweight inference-time strategy for improving the prior-driven recovery of unobservable image components in DDNM-based inverse solvers.
sents.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 CPF-DDNM，这是一种轻量级的推理时策略，旨在提升基于 DDNM 的反向求解器中不可观测图像成分的先验驱动恢复效果。

sents.en: The method exploits information already available along the reverse diffusion trajectory by combining consecutive measurement-aware estimates, without modifying or retraining the diffusion prior.
sents.zh: 该方法通过结合连续的测量感知估计值，利用反向扩散轨迹中已有的信息，而无需修改或重新训练扩散先验。

paragraphs.en: The range/null-space decomposition of DDNM provides a direct geometric interpretation of the proposed fusion. With an exact Moore–Penrose pseudo-inverse, consecutive DDNM corrections share the same measurement-determined component and differ only in the null-space of the forward operator. CPF-DDNM therefore modifies exclusively the prior-driven component while preserving the information determined by the measurements. Thus, for noiseless data, CPF-DDNM preserves exact data consistency. Our local error analysis further provides conditions under which the extrapolative optimal fusion coefficient can yield a small null-space recovery error.
paragraphs.zh: DDNM 的域/零空间分解为所提出的融合方法提供了直接的几何解释。 在精确的 Moore–Penrose 伪逆条件下，连续的 DDNM 修正共享相同的由测量值决定的分量，仅在前向算子的零空间上存在差异。 因此，CPF-DDNM 仅修改由先验知识驱动的分量，同时保留由测量值决定的信息。 因此，对于无噪声数据，CPF-DDNM 能够保持精确的数据一致性。 我们的局部误差分析进一步提供了在何种条件下，外推最优融合系数能够产生较小的零空间恢复误差。

sents.zh: DDNM 的域/零空间分解为所提出的融合方法提供了直接的几何解释。

sents.en: Thus, for noiseless data, CPF-DDNM preserves exact data consistency.
sents.zh: 因此，对于无噪声数据，CPF-DDNM 能够保持精确的数据一致性。

sents.en: Our local error analysis further provides conditions under which the extrapolative optimal fusion coefficient can yield a small null-space recovery error.
sents.zh: 我们的局部误差分析进一步提供了在何种条件下，外推最优融合系数能够产生较小的零空间恢复误差。

paragraphs.en: Experiments demonstrate that the benefits of consecutive posterior fusion depend on both the forward operator and the fusion schedule. The largest gains were observed in sparse-view CT, where CPF-DDNM consistently improved upon DDNM across acquisition geometries and noise levels, and outperformed the considered diffusion-based inverse solvers. In super-resolution, CPF-DDNM improved structural similarity over DDNM, although DiffPIR achieved better average performance for some metrics in the noisy setting. The method was effective with both numerically approximated pseudo-inverses in CT and an analytically available pseudo-inverse in super-resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，连续后验融合的优势既取决于正向算子，也取决于融合调度方案。 在稀疏视图CT中观察到了最大的增益，其中CPF-DDNM在各种采集几何构型和噪声水平下始终优于DDNM，并且表现优于所考虑的基于扩散的反向求解器。 在超分辨率领域，CPF-DDNM在结构相似性方面优于DDNM，尽管在存在噪声的情况下，DiffPIR在某些指标上取得了更好的平均性能。 该方法在CT中使用的数值近似伪逆以及在超分辨率中使用的解析可得伪逆上都表现出有效性。

sents.en: Experiments demonstrate that the benefits of consecutive posterior fusion depend on both the forward operator and the fusion schedule.
sents.zh: 实验表明，连续后验融合的优势既取决于正向算子，也取决于融合调度方案。

sents.en: The largest gains were observed in sparse-view CT, where CPF-DDNM consistently improved upon DDNM across acquisition geometries and noise levels, and outperformed the considered diffusion-based inverse solvers.
sents.zh: 在稀疏视图CT中观察到了最大的增益，其中CPF-DDNM在各种采集几何构型和噪声水平下始终优于DDNM，并且表现优于所考虑的基于扩散的反向求解器。

sents.en: In super-resolution, CPF-DDNM improved structural similarity over DDNM, although DiffPIR achieved better average performance for some metrics in the noisy setting.
sents.zh: 在超分辨率领域，CPF-DDNM在结构相似性方面优于DDNM，尽管在存在噪声的情况下，DiffPIR在某些指标上取得了更好的平均性能。

sents.en: The method was effective with both numerically approximated pseudo-inverses in CT and an analytically available pseudo-inverse in super-resolution.
sents.zh: 该方法在CT中使用的数值近似伪逆以及在超分辨率中使用的解析可得伪逆上都表现出有效性。

paragraphs.en: CPF-DDNM requires no additional denoiser evaluations or pseudo-inverse operations compared with DDNM, adding only the storage of the preceding correction and a linear combination. The main remaining limitation is the selection of the fusion schedule, which is currently determined on validation data and depends on the forward operator. Future work will investigate adaptive inference-time strategies based on quantities such as consecutive correction variations and data residuals, as well as plugging the CPF strategy to different posterior sampling methods.
paragraphs.zh: 与 DDNM 相比，CPF-DDNM 无需额外的去噪器评估或伪逆运算，只需存储前一次校正结果并进行线性组合。 目前的主要限制在于融合时序的选择，该时序当前是在验证数据上确定的，并且依赖于正向算子。 未来的工作将研究基于连续校正变化和数据残差等量的自适应推理时策略，以及将 CPF 策略应用于不同的后验采样方法。
